summary: Deep (GADT) embedding of Montague's IL: ILType inductive (e, t, arrow, s), denotation domains Den with Den t = Prop, intrinsically-typed IL terms with de Bruijn variables and a baked-in PTQ lexicon, and an eval function mirroring the interpretation clauses of pp. 23-25 (lambda, app, =, connectives, quantifiers, W, H, up/down). Hand-written IL renderings of Section-4 sentences (every man walks, seek-a-unicorn de dicto/de re, the temperature puzzle triple) with eval-correspondence theorems; up-down identity, beta soundness, and one beta-equivalence proved; the temperature-puzzle non-entailment proved Qed but conditionally on 6 section hypotheses over abstract Parameters (no concrete countermodel). Meaning postulates 2 and 9 stated as IL formulas but asserted as Coq Axioms. The Eng analysis-tree type is defined yet never translated: T1(d)/T4/T5 exist as combinators, T2 is discussed in a 230-line comment but not defined, so the headline T1-T17 pipeline is unrealized. Two deviations from PTQ verified against DWP 1981: ty_iv result type is <s,t> instead of PTQ's f(IV)=<<s,e>,t> (the source of the file's self-diagnosed type tension, patched with explicit down), and nec_ is 'necessarily now' (worlds only) where PTQ's box is 'necessarily always' (all world-time pairs).

evidence: The IL syntax/semantics apparatus (ILType, GADT terms, eval clauses for lambda/app/=/connectives/quantifiers/W/H/up/down) tracks pp. 23-25 up to a fixed lexicon, and all 13 theorems end in Qed (grep '^Theorem' undercounts at 9; Qed count 13; the one 'Admitted' grep hit is a comment).

Core type assignment changed: ty_iv = <<s,e>,<s,t>> vs PTQ's f(IV) = <<s,e>,t> (verified against DWP (7-2) and Appendix III); every hand-written translation carries extra down operators PTQ's formulas do not have, and the file's own 230-line comment discovers the mismatch mid-file, blaming 'Montague's implicit notation' for a deviation of its own making.

nec_ evaluates at all worlds with time held fixed; PTQ's box quantifies over all world-time pairs (DWP pp. 132-133 explicitly says Montague used 'necessarily always' in PTQ), so the meaning postulates stated via nec_ differ in content from p. 28.

The headline claim of PTQ — a compositional translation from analysis trees to IL (T1-T17) — is stated as the file's purpose (header, Part 8) but not delivered: Eng is defined and never consumed; only T1(d)/T4/T5 combinators exist.

The temperature-puzzle non-entailment is genuinely established over the file's variant IL, but only conditionally on 6 explicit hypotheses about Parameter denotations; two meaning postulates are asserted as global Coq Axioms (Print Assumptions of anything using them would list man_extensional / seek_is_try_to_find).

determination_rationale: Per rubric section 4, only a partial formalization exists in this file: a core definition (the category-to-type map, hence every derived type and every translation) is changed relative to PTQ, one interpretation clause (box) is changed, and the headline T1-T17 pipeline is missing. Important caveat: the changes appear self-inflicted rather than forced — PTQ's own f(IV) = <<s,e>,t> dissolves the <s,t>/t tension the file struggled with, and 'necessarily always' is directly definable in the same eval. So this verdict is a ceiling imposed by this pilot file, not a diagnosis of the theory; PTQ plausibly admits as_is or slight_modification under a corrected type assignment (the deep-embedding cost is class (iv) machinery, not a foundational obstacle).

artifact_classes.description: typed object syntax needs an intrinsically-typed GADT with de Bruijn indices and computed Env types; heterogeneous constant lookup avoided by baking the lexicon into constructors; Montague's implicit index-relative assertion must become an explicit down constructor

the two-element truth-value domain D_t is rendered as Prop, identifying truth values with propositions; Classical is imported (undocumented) to license the identification though no proof in the file uses it

notes: Record produced by the batch audit sweep of 2026-09-05; the file predates the atlas zero-axiom discipline (28 signature Parameters, 2 propositional Axioms, undocumented Classical import, no Print Assumptions). Header misnames the file PTQ_deep.v; 5-6 of the 13 Qed theorems are definitional unfoldings a verifier would exclude from counts; companion files shallow/PTQ.v and deep/theorems_deep_PTQ.v not audited here.
